items.name: Cost Management
items.description: Resource tagging for cost allocation; rightsizing reviews monthly; reserved instances for steady-state

items.name: Disaster Recovery
items.description: DR strategy documented (Pilot Light, Warm Standby, Active-Active); tested quarterly
fragments: DR strategy documented (Pilot Light, Warm Standby, Active-Active)

items.name: High Availability
items.description: Multi-AZ deployment required for production; RPO/RTO documented; auto-scaling configured

items.name: Infrastructure as Code
items.description: Terraform (preferred) or Bicep; no manual changes; GitOps workflow; drift detection enabled

items.name: Landing Zone Standards
items.description: Standard subscription structure; network topology; identity integration; policy guardrails

items.name: Network Architecture
items.description: Hub-spoke topology; private endpoints; no public IPs except load balancers; NSG/firewall rules documented
fragments: no public IPs except load balancers

items.name: Resource Naming Convention
items.description: Standard naming: {env}-{region}-{app}-{resource}-{instance}; tags required: Owner, CostCenter, Environment

items.name: Analytics Architecture
items.description: Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold); semantic layer for BI; governed self-service

items.name: Data Catalog
items.description: All datasets registered; business glossary linked; stewardship assigned; searchable metadata

items.name: Data Lineage
items.description: End-to-end lineage captured; automated discovery preferred; lineage published to catalog

items.name: Data Modeling Standards
items.description: Conceptual, logical, physical models required; ERD in approved tool; naming conventions enforced

items.name: Data Quality Standards
items.description: Quality rules defined; profiling automated; DQ scores published; remediation SLAs

items.name: ETL/ELT Standards
items.description: ELT preferred for cloud; idempotent pipelines; schema evolution handled; data contracts enforced

items.name: Master Data Management
items.description: Golden records for Customer, Policy, Claim, Product; MDM hub for cross-domain resolution
fragments: Golden records for Customer, Policy, Claim, Product

items.name: Architecture Diagram Standards
items.description: C4 model (Context, Container, Component, Code); draw.io or LucidChart; version controlled

items.name: Architecture Repository
items.description: Confluence for documentation; Git for diagrams-as-code; searchable and maintained

items.name: Non-Functional Requirements
items.description: NFRs documented per project: performance, scalability, availability, security, compliance
fragments: NFRs documented per project: performance, scalability, availability, security, compliance

items.name: Runbook Requirements
items.description: Operational runbooks required before go-live; stored in wiki; reviewed quarterly

items.name: Sequence Diagrams
items.description: Required for complex flows; PlantUML or Mermaid; stored with code

items.name: Approved Cloud Platforms
items.description: Azure (primary), AWS (secondary for specific workloads); multi-cloud by exception only

items.name: Approved Databases
items.description: PostgreSQL, SQL Server for OLTP; Snowflake, Databricks for analytics; Redis for caching; MongoDB for document stores

items.name: Approved Integration
items.description: Azure API Management for API gateway; MuleSoft for legacy integration; GraphQL for BFF patterns
fragments: Azure API Management for API gateway

items.name: Approved Languages
items.description: Java 17+, Python 3.10+, TypeScript/Node.js 18+, C# .NET 6+; exceptions require ARB approval

items.name: Approved Messaging
items.description: Azure Service Bus, Kafka for event streaming; RabbitMQ deprecated; no new TIBCO implementations
fragments: Azure Service Bus, Kafka for event streaming

items.name: Approved Observability
items.description: Azure Monitor, Dynatrace for APM; Splunk for logs; PagerDuty for alerting; Grafana for dashboards

items.name: CI/CD Tooling
items.description: Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for pipelines; SonarQube for quality gates; Artifactory for artifacts
fragments: Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for pipelines

items.name: Container Platforms
items.description: AKS (Kubernetes) for container orchestration; Docker for local development; Helm for packaging
